title: Grill — collapse / expand the task messages backlog

surface.title: Which “backlog” should collapse?
surface.display: The saved-drafts tray above the composer

default-state.title: What state should the tray open in?

auto-threshold.title: At how many saved messages should the tray auto-collapse?

persistence.title: How long should your collapse choice be remembered?

edit-conflict.title: What happens if you collapse while a saved message is being edited inline?

save-while-collapsed.title: When a new draft is saved while the tray is collapsed, should it expand?

collapsed-header.title: What should the collapsed header show?
collapsed-header.display: Keep it, but swap the hint when collapsed

expanded-height.title: Does “expand” mean the current capped list, or show more?

interaction.title: Interaction and accessibility
interaction.value: Whole header is one full-width `<button>` with a leading chevron; `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; `data-testid` hooks (`backlog-tray`, `backlog-toggle`, `backlog-list`) and `data-state`; no height animation, only the chevron rotates.

always-visible.title: Show the collapse toggle for every non-empty tray, even with one draft
always-visible.value: Yes — always show it when the tray renders.

archived.title: Same toggle on archived (read-only) tasks
archived.value: Yes — collapse is pure view state; drafts stay visible when expanded and the read-only hint remains.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle edges
lifecycle.value: Subagent tabs still hide the tray entirely; an empty backlog still hides it; after the last draft is sent or deleted, a later draft follows the stored choice (collapsed if you last collapsed).

non-goals.title: Out of scope
non-goals.value: Per-message collapse, expand-all/collapse-all, virtualization for huge lists, backend/preference sync, a Settings toggle, and a new keyboard shortcut.

acceptance.title: Tests and docs
acceptance.value: One new Playwright spec (default visibility, toggle + `aria-expanded`, list hidden, count visible, transcript grows) plus an update to `docs/architecture/messages-backlog.md`; add `CLAUDE.md:175` only if a new localStorage key is introduced. The existing task-switch spec changes only if the chosen default hides its seeded draft.

other-constraints.title: Any other behavior, copy or constraint this must respect?
